# Vellum — AI Study Notebooks

> Vellum is an AI-powered educational study companion and learning platform. It transforms any document, textbook, or learning topic into interactive flashcards, unlimited self-testing quizzes, revision notes, and grounded question answering.

## Core Capabilities
- **Document to Study Kit**: Ingests PDFs, lecture slides, text, and course materials to automatically generate structured study kits.
- **Active Recall Flashcards**: Interactive digital flip cards with confidence ratings and mastery tracking.
- **Dynamic Quiz Engine**: Unlimited multiple-choice and conceptual practice questions with instant explanatory feedback.
- **Grounded AI Tutor**: Answers student questions strictly based on the provided material with citations.
- **National Curriculum Library**: Complete digital library of Ethiopian textbooks (Grades 7 to 12 across Natural and Social sciences) in English, Amharic, Afaan Oromoo, and Tigrinya.
- **Study Breaks & Educational Games**: Curated brain break games with daily playtime limits to balance studying and wellness.

## Main Public Routes
- **[Home / Landing Page](https://vellumstudy.vercel.app/)**: Overview of Vellum, features, and instant onboarding.
- **[Curriculum Library](https://vellumstudy.vercel.app/library)**: Browse textbooks, supplementary books, open-access curriculum materials by grade and subject.
- **[Educational Games](https://vellumstudy.vercel.app/games)**: Brain break games zone.
- **[Sign In](https://vellumstudy.vercel.app/login)**: Student and educator authentication.
- **[Sign Up](https://vellumstudy.vercel.app/signup)**: Free student account creation.
- **[Privacy Policy](https://vellumstudy.vercel.app/privacy)**: Data privacy and student protection policy.
- **[Terms of Service](https://vellumstudy.vercel.app/terms)**: Platform terms of use.
